policy: Named Pleiades systems (the Seven Sisters, Atlas and Pleione), the classical Theta1 Orionis A-D Trapezium systems, and the brightest distance-consistent SIMBAD catalogued members of the Hyades, Coma Star Cluster, IC 2602, IC 2391 and the Beehive. Foreground Aldebaran and Gamma Comae Berenices are excluded. This is a visual landmark set, not a complete membership census. Sun is included only as the map origin.

groups.name: Pleiades
groups.selection: The Seven Sisters plus Atlas and Pleione; exact Hipparcos identifiers with SIMBAD Melotte 22 membership aliases.

groups.name: Trapezium Cluster
groups.selection: The four classical bright Trapezium systems at the heart of the Orion Nebula.

groups.name: Hyades
groups.selection: Eight brightest SIMBAD Melotte 25 members with cluster-consistent parallaxes; foreground Aldebaran is deliberately excluded.

groups.name: Coma Star Cluster
groups.selection: Five brightest SIMBAD Melotte 111 members with cluster-consistent parallaxes; foreground Gamma Comae Berenices is excluded.

groups.name: Southern Pleiades
groups.selection: Five brightest SIMBAD IC 2602 members with cluster-consistent parallaxes.

groups.name: Omicron Velorum Cluster
groups.selection: Six brightest SIMBAD IC 2391 members with cluster-consistent parallaxes.

groups.name: Beehive Cluster
groups.selection: Five brightest SIMBAD NGC 2632 members with cluster-consistent parallaxes.
